name: zoom-whiteboard
description: Bring Zoom's whiteboard collaboration into your ChatGPT conversations. Use your conversational context to create whiteboards, generate diagrams from Mermaid scripts, and list or retrieve existing whiteboards on demand. Streamline your workflow by turning ChatGPT's insights and diagrams into visual whiteboards in Zoom, keeping your team aligned and productive.

interface.longDescription: Bring Zoom's whiteboard collaboration into your ChatGPT conversations. Use your conversational context to create whiteboards, generate diagrams from Mermaid scripts, and list or retrieve existing whiteboards on demand. Streamline your workflow by turning ChatGPT's insights and diagrams into visual whiteboards in Zoom, keeping your team aligned and productive.
defaultPrompt: Create a brainstorming whiteboard for a product launch planning session.
Create a flowchart that explains our customer onboarding process.

positive.description: List boards accessible to the dedicated reviewer account. Setup: sign in through the secure reviewer credentials step; prepare at least one disposable sample board in that account. Follow pagination if the tool returns it. No mutations.
positive.prompt: Can you get me a list of my whiteboards?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_whiteboards for the connected user context using the current schema. Return board names and IDs matching the actual result, with share links and last-modified dates only when returned or documented. Do not fabricate boards or dates. Handle an empty result explicitly. Retain a returned board ID as the selected test board for case 2.

positive.description: Read the sample board selected from case 1. Conversation context must include its exact returned ID and name, replacing the original placeholder. Reviewer account must have read access. No mutations.
positive.prompt: Can you give me the details of the sample whiteboard we selected from my list?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_a_whiteboard with whiteboard_id equal to the selected board's returned ID. Return its name, owner, creation date, and other metadata when supplied by the result. Omit unavailable fields rather than inventing them. Ask for a selection if context is missing or ambiguous.

positive.description: Create disposable boards under the reviewer account, which must have whiteboard creation access and the needed AI features. Run both turns to cover brainstorming and the advertised Mermaid diagram capability. Prompt 2 is a follow-up in the same conversation. Do not overwrite existing boards.
positive.prompt: Can you create a mindmap of AI era 2026? Then create a separate customer onboarding flowchart using the Mermaid script: flowchart LR; Signup-->Welcome; Welcome-->Setup; Setup-->FirstSuccess.
positive.expected_behavior: Use create_a_whiteboard_for_brainstorming with the requested topic and coherent branch content according to its live schema. Use create_a_whiteboard_by_script with the supplied Mermaid flow and a separate board title according to its live schema. Return actual created board references. Verify the mindmap has its requested topic and branches and the diagram has Signup, Welcome, Setup, and FirstSuccess in order. If either call fails, identify the failed step without claiming completion.

positive.description: Use the disposable mindmap from case 3 and an eligible collaborator identity supplied privately in secure reviewer instructions. The original named employee address is not embedded in this public package. Reviewer account must own the board and be allowed to share it. Run the three requests sequentially; complete host-required confirmations.
positive.prompt: Share the mindmap whiteboard we just created with the designated test collaborator as an editor. Then make them a commenter. Then remove them from its collaborators.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the actual board ID and provided eligible collaborator identity. If the identity is absent, ask before sharing. Add editor access, read back collaborator state, update only that collaborator to commenter, read back, remove only that collaborator after required confirmation, and verify absence. Use current role values and identifiers from live schemas, not guessed codes. Preserve other collaborators; report partial failures truthfully.

positive.description: Use a disposable board created in case 3 with an editable first page and record its initial objects. Run the three requests sequentially. Reviewer must have content read/write/delete access. Confirm the triangle to delete using the returned object ID, and obtain host-required deletion confirmation.
positive.prompt: How many objects are on the first page of the mindmap whiteboard we just created? Then add a triangle and a rectangle to that page. Then delete only the triangle you just added.
positive.expected_behavior: Read first-page content and count its actual objects, stating the page limitation. Add one triangle and one rectangle using the selected board/page and valid objects from current schemas. Read back to verify both new objects and their IDs. Delete only the new triangle's returned ID; read back to verify the rectangle and all original objects remain. Do not claim counts across unreturned pages or invent IDs.

negative.description: Meeting scheduling is outside Whiteboard capabilities. Explain that a meeting/calendar capability is needed. Do not invoke Whiteboard tools, create a board as a substitute, or claim a meeting was scheduled.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team for next Tuesday at 2pm.

negative.description: Editing a Zoom Doc is outside Whiteboard capabilities. Explain that a Canvas/Docs capability is needed. Do not invoke Whiteboard tools or claim the document was edited.
negative.prompt: Edit the second paragraph of my Zoom Doc about quarterly goals.

negative.description: Fetching a meeting transcript is outside Whiteboard capabilities. Explain that a meeting/recording capability or supplied transcript is needed. Do not invoke Whiteboard tools or invent transcript content.
negative.prompt: Summarize the transcript from my last team standup meeting.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Zoom Whiteboard for ChatGPT. Create whiteboards for brainstorming, strategy analysis, and diagramming directly from ChatGPT. List and retrieve your existing whiteboards, manage collaborators, and generate Mermaid-based diagrams — all without leaving your conversation.
